Name: Belch Flame
Description: You bite into a piece of charcoal as if it were an apple, bursting the material components in your mouth and then spitting out a blazing inferno into a 30-ft long cone in front of you, forcing all creatures inside to pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer 2d4 fire damage and 3 Burn count, or half that fire damage on a success and no Condition inflicted. If there are more than four creatures within that reach the heat spreads more intensely, dealing an additional d4 of fire damage and 2 Burn Count.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you deal an additional d4 fire damage and inflict 1 Burn count for each second slot level above 2nd.
